name: B10-0168/2025 (ECR) – Continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to keep backing Ukraine against Russia's war, now three years old. It asks for more weapons, including long-range missiles and air defence, tougher sanctions on Russia, and the use of frozen Russian money to pay for damage. It says Ukraine should decide for itself whether to negotiate peace, and that any deal needs security guarantees. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks for more weapons and sanctions; no law changes yet.
- It affects Ukraine, Russia, and European Union governments.
- Next, governments and the Commission decide whether to act on these calls.
